mapper.select: SELECT booth_item_id, booth_id, name, type, image_url, note FROM booth_item WHERE booth_id = #{boothId} ORDER BY booth_item_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO booth (application_id, business_id, confirmed_at) VALUES (#{applicationId}, #{businessId}, #{confirmedAt})
INSERT INTO booth_item (booth_id, name, type, image_url, note) VALUES (#{boothId}, #{name}, #{type}, #{imageUrl}, #{note})
mapper.select: SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fairs WHERE fair_id = #{fairId})

SELECT bt.booth_id AS boothId, biz.name AS businessName, bt.image_url AS imageUrl, bs.slot_number AS slotNumber, bs.pos_x AS posX, bs.pos_y AS posY, bs.width AS width, bs.height AS height, h.hall_id AS hallId, h.name AS hallName, h.floor_plan_image_url AS floorPlanImageUrl FROM booth bt JOIN business biz ON biz.business_id = bt.business_id JOIN application_slot aps ON aps.application_id = bt.application_id JOIN booth_slots bs ON bs.booth_slot_id = aps.booth_slot_id JOIN halls h ON h.hall_id = bs.hall_id WHERE h.fair_id = #{fairId} ORDER BY bs.slot_number

SELECT b.booth_id AS boothId, b.name AS name, b.image_url AS imageUrl, b.category AS category, b.target_animal AS targetAnimal, a.fair_id AS fairId, f.name AS fairName FROM booth_favorites bf JOIN booth b ON b.booth_id = bf.booth_id JOIN application a ON a.application_id = b.application_id JOIN fairs f ON f.fair_id = a.fair_id WHERE bf.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY bf.created_at DESC
mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO booth_favorites (user_id, booth_id, created_at) VALUES (#{userId}, #{boothId}, NOW())
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM booth_favorites WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND booth_id = #{boothId}
mapper.select: SELECT b.booth_id AS boothId, b.name AS name, b.image_url AS imageUrl, b.category AS category, b.target_animal AS targetAnimal, a.fair_id AS fairId, f.name AS fairName FROM booth b JOIN application a ON a.application_id = b.application_id JOIN fairs f ON f.fair_id = a.fair_id JOIN business biz ON biz.business_id = b.business_id WHERE biz.owner_id = #{userId} ORDER BY b.confirmed_at DESC

SELECT bv.fair_id AS fairId, f.name AS fairName FROM booth_visits bv JOIN fairs f ON f.fair_id = bv.fair_id WHERE bv.user_id = #{userId} GROUP BY bv.fair_id, f.name ORDER BY MAX(bv.last_visited_at) DESC

SELECT bv.booth_id AS boothId, b.name AS name, b.image_url AS imageUrl, bv.first_visited_at AS firstVisitedAt, bv.visit_count AS visitCount FROM booth_visits bv JOIN booth b ON b.booth_id = bv.booth_id WHERE bv.user_id = #{userId} AND bv.fair_id = #{fairId} ORDER BY bv.first_visited_at DESC
